# On android a child a caller writes into a component's slot, which the
# component puts in a vbox, takes its flex as a share of that vbox -- whether
# the component is spliced or built at run time. The vbox wraps its slot in
# flexShare, and the context lowering hands the content that value
# (collectSlotEnv); it had looked only at providers written in the
# component's own body, so the content read its caller's share, here the
# stack's fillMaxSize, and pushed `bottom` off the screen.
#
# `spliced.sngl` and `built.sngl` snapshot the component spliced and built at
# run time; `shown.sngl` writes the same nodes in a vbox, and the three must
# be one picture.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric spliced.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric built.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp spliced.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png shown.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png
cmp built.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png shown.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/shown.png

-- spliced.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component panel(content ...component ui.node) ui.node {
    var clicks = 0

    ui.vbox(style={flex=1}) {
        ui.button(text="{clicks}", @click { clicks += 1 })
        content
    }
}

func testShown(t test.Test) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

ui.window(title="Flex") {
    ui.stack(style={flex=1}) {
        panel {
            ui.text(value="top")
            ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
                ui.text(value="grows")
            }
            ui.text(value="bottom")
        }
    }
}
-- built.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var details = true

component panel(content ...component ui.node) ui.node {
    var clicks = 0

    ui.vbox(style={flex=1}) {
        ui.button(text="{clicks}", @click { clicks += 1 })
        content
    }
}

func testShown(t test.Test) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

ui.window(title="Flex") {
    ui.stack(style={flex=1}) {
        if details {
            panel {
                ui.text(value="top")
                ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
                    ui.text(value="grows")
                }
                ui.text(value="bottom")
            }
        }
    }
}
-- shown.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var clicks = 0

func testShown(t test.Test) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

ui.window(title="Flex") {
    ui.stack(style={flex=1}) {
        ui.vbox(style={flex=1}) {
            ui.button(text="{clicks}", @click { clicks += 1 })
            ui.text(value="top")
            ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
                ui.text(value="grows")
            }
            ui.text(value="bottom")
        }
    }
}
